title: sse: fix streaming chunking/framing for partial JSON + delimiter/token ordering
author: Evan Chen
description: Fixes a set of related SSE streaming regressions observed when emitting partial JSON chunks and mixed token/event framing. Root causes: (1) delimiter insertion logic could emit delimiter tokens out of order when partial JSON payloads and token events interleave; (2) the framing state machine could flush a chunk mid-object leading to invalid partial JSON delivered to clients; (3) OpenAI-compat streaming layer did not consistently annotate token events with explicit 'delimiter' markers, making downstream reassembly brittle. This PR: Unifies SSE framing into a single deterministic state machine that tracks open/closed JSON tokens and explicit delimiter tokens; ensures delimiter events are emitted before token events when both are produced in the same step; adds a safe chunk boundary policy: never cut inside an active JSON string or between a key and its value token (if necessary, extend chunk to include closing delimiter or emit an explicit continuation marker); adds compatibility shims for OpenAI-compat layer to preserve original event ordering for legacy clients while emitting explicit delimiter annotations for new clients; adds unit, integration, and an end-to-end smoke test that simulates interleaved token/delimiter production and partial-object streaming over flaky connections. Motivation/context: Incidents (SUP-8721) and internal canaries showed client-side JSON parsers occasionally received invalid partial JSON during high-concurrency streams, causing downstream structured-output pipelines to drop requests or return garbage. This change fixes correctness and reduces token replays seen by the reassembly layer. Checklist: [x] Add deterministic state machine for SSE framing; [x] Preserve OpenAI-compat ordering for legacy consumers; [x] Add unit and integration tests; [x] Update docs and add a note in API compatibility guide; [x] Validate against canary scenarios and load tests. Related: similar fixes in the past (see pr-121462, pr-160123).

diff_snippets: @@ services/streaming/sse/stream_writer.go +120, +156 -    // previous naive delimiter insertion -    if payloadDelimiter { write(\"\n\") } +    // now use deterministic state machine to decide exact ordering and safe boundaries +    for _, ev := range sm.DrainPending() { write(ev.Serialize()) }

@@ compat/openai/stream_compat.go +45 -    // legacy clients relied on implicit ordering -    emitTokenEvent(token) -    if shouldEmitDelimiter { emitDelimiter() } +    // explicitly annotate events and preserve legacy token-first ordering behind flag +    if cfg.LegacyOrdering { emitTokenEvent(token); if shouldEmitDelimiter { emitDelimiter() } } else { sm.QueueDelimiterThenToken(token, shouldEmitDelimiter) }
